title: OpenCRS 0.1 validation report
description: Whether one creative file meets one target's requirements.

result.description: fail if any check is an error; otherwise incomplete if any is not_checked; otherwise warn if any is a warning; otherwise pass.

checks.description: Findings only. Checks that passed are not listed.

network.description: For a finding about a screens.json caused at one level of it: the network. Such a finding is reported once and lists no screens.

venue.description: With network: the venue the finding is about.

format.description: With network: the format the finding is about.

screens.description: Screen ids the finding applies to, in document order, when it doesn't apply to every screen of the target. At most 1,000; screens_total says how many there are when the list is cut short.

screens_total.description: How many screens the finding applies to. Present only when screens is cut short.

source.description: Where the measured value came from.

attestation.description: For a check only a person can judge: who attested to it in the manifest, and when. The validator checked only that it names this file.
